diagnostic_design.candidates: shm_mount_evidence considers every row covering /dev/shm, including all exact /dev/shm entries, in original file order. It records selected mount ID/index, candidate count, equal-longest count and ambiguity. Exact candidate raw strings are retained only within a measured serialized envelope; incomplete retention explicitly refuses before IPC.
diagnostic_design.fd_discriminator: Already-open context[ipc] descriptor is passed only to read bounded /proc/self/fdinfo/<fd>. Exact fdinfo plus its one decimal mnt_id is evidence. No comparison changes mount acceptance; source reader can distinguish selected covered row ID from the opened descriptor mount ID.
diagnostic_design.no_full_mountinfo_claim: Raw mountinfo still read at unchanged65536-byte/512-row/2048-row-character limits. The envelope is not a full raw mountinfo archive. candidate_lines_joined_LF_sha256 hashes exact candidate row strings joined by one LF, without claiming original newline-byte recovery.
diagnostic_design.ordering: record_os_evidence places mounts (four selected parsed records),uid_map,gid_map into report before old dev/shm/alias assertions. It then adds candidate/FD diagnostics. Read/format/budget failures remain explicit failures with available partial observations.
diagnostic_design.overflow: If compact full report exceeds original MAX_RESULT8192, status is forced FAILED as in v1. Bounded mount evidence survives in a smaller failure envelope with original rendered byte count/hash, omitted field count/key-roster hash,mandatory_evidence_discarded=true,cleanup_verified=false,qualification=false. Parsed mounts/maps/cleanup may then be NOT_RETAINED; no complete diagnostic or qualification claim is permitted.

diagnostic_design.unchanged_selector: mount_record is AST/byte-text unchanged: select first row with the longest covering mountpoint; equal-length/equal-path later rows do not replace it. No tie resolution or mount predicate repair.

mechanical_bounds.other_resources: No output/tmpfs/cgroup/inode/archive/reserve/deadline/topology increase. Existing collector32MiB/1024inode output and separate restore,8MiB archive,4MiB receipts,8GiB/swap0 and original owner/admission gates remain outside this probe and unchanged.
mechanical_bounds.row_retention_enforcement: Before accepting a raw row, serialize candidate evidence and reject addition above2816B (3072-256). After fixed scalar accounting, recheck<=2816B. fd mount ID is one decimal string of1..20 digits, then explicit final serialized<=3072B. Incomplete candidate evidence forces refusal. These are checked byte limits, not a formal whole-Python memory proof.
mechanical_bounds.selected_id_bound: Exact selected ID limited64chars for bounded diagnostic metadata only; longer value has sha256 plus exact=false/IDnull,complete=false and refusal. Original mount selector/predicate is not relaxed.
mechanical_bounds.stdout_enforcement: Original full compact report tested against8192; fallback uses only bounded candidate evidence and fixed metadata/counts/hashes, then checks8192 again. Overflow/incomplete never returns success.
